title: PMETs Assisted Under Career Support Programme
what_it_is: PMETs Assisted Under Career Support Programme

sections.label: CSP placements and employment outcomes
sections.summary: Since October 2015 over 1,100 PMETs were supported through CSP, placements rose from about 200 in 2016 to over 800 in 2017, and about 70% stayed employed within 12 months.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister of Manpower)
sentences.text: Since its inception in October 2015, over 1,100 PMETs have been supported through CSP.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister of Manpower)
sentences.text: More than 90% were aged 40 and above, and more than 80% were long-term unemployed at the point of placement.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister of Manpower)
sentences.text: Placements have steadily picked up, from about 200 in the first three quarters of 2016, to more than 800 in the same period in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister of Manpower)
sentences.text: Within 12 months of CSP placement, about 70% remained in employment.

sections.label: CSP outreach to SMEs
sections.summary: CSP has run about two years, outreach to SMEs can improve, and SME take-up is about half.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The CSP has been on-going for just about two years.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We accept the fact that we can improve on outreach and enable more employers to know about the help that is available to them, and will certainly strengthen the outreach, particularly to SMEs.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: As it stands right now, the outreach to the SMEs, or at least if you look at the numbers, SMEs take-up is not too bad – it is about half.

sections.label: Answers with assessment rigour
sections.summary: The answers to those questions are yes, while always maintaining a certain rigour in the assessment.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The answers to those questions are indeed, yes, but always maintaining a certain rigour in the assessment.
